chapter: Regal Theatre and the changing music scene
title: The Regal and the start of rock and roll
summary: At the Regal he saw B. B. King, Gladys Knight, the Temptations and others begin on the chitlin circuit.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. Right, right. And -- but then I said, like, the Regal Theatre, when I went in it, then a new -- you're going into a new era now. All these are the things that happened before, but now you're going into the new era of the -- B.B. King became very popular during this particular time. He's been around, but he was just a joint blues singer. So he became a big name. Gladys Knight and the Pips, the Temptations, and -- you name it, they all started there. I mean, started, because they had just gotten -- were getting their acts and things together and maybe made one record. Then they would play this
circuit, like the Apollo Theatre in New York, and then they [Uptown Theater] would go to Philadelphia and then they would come to Chicago and Chicago, with the theatre here.
So then I got a chance to see the other side of the coin, the -- what the beginning of the rock and roll era. So this is --
